item.title: Festival de los Andes - New Date — Sat Oct 10, 2:00 PM — AMPHITHEATER MONTCLAIR STATE UNIVERSITY
item.description: Celebrate the rich cultures and traditions of the Andean region at the second annual Festival de los Andes at Montclair State University! Join us on Saturday, September 26, from 2:00–7:00 p.m. at the Amphitheater on our campus for an afternoon of live Andean music, traditional dance, singing, artists and artisans, interactive cultural workshops, food, and family-friendly activities. Organized by CLaSE (Center for Latino heritage and Spanish language Excellence) and community partners, the festival brings together the University and surrounding communities to celebrate, learn from, and experience the cultural diversity and living traditions of the Andes. item.title: Festival de los Andes at Montclair State University (Rain date) — Sat Oct 10, 2:00 PM — AMPHITHEATER MONTCLAIR STATE UNIVERSITY
item.description:
Join us at Montclair State University for the Festival de los Andes, a vibrant, family-friendly celebration of the cultures and Indigenous traditions of the Andean region. Experience an afternoon of live music and dance, artists and artisans, interactive cultural workshops, food, family activities, and more, with performances and traditions representing Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia, and Argentina. This year’s expanded festival features 12 performing groups and a special Women’s Voices program bringing together singers representing Colombia, Ecuador, Bolivia, and Peru. More than a festival, it is a space for the University and surrounding communities to come together through culture, learning, connection, and celebration. Free and open to the community. item.title: Theater League of Clifton Announces Auditions for “1776” — Sat Oct 10, 7:00 PM — NJ
item.description: The Theater League of Clifton will hold auditions for its upcoming production of “1776” on Tuesday, September 15; Wednesday, September 16; and Thursday, September 17, from 7:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Callbacks by invitation may also be held Thursday, September 17. Auditions will be held at Living Hope, 303 Maplewood Ave., Clifton, NJ 07013. Performances will be held November 13, 14 and 15 at the Wayne Community Center, 1 Pike Drive, Wayne, NJ. The production will be directed by Maren Sugarman. With music and lyrics by Sherman Edwards and a book by Peter Stone, 1776 dramatizes the struggle within the Second Continental Congress to declare American independence. John Adams, Benjamin Franklin and Thomas Jefferson attempt to persuade a divided Congress to break with England while political, regional and personal conflicts threaten to derail the effort. item.title: Relationship Red Flags vs Green Flags — Wed Oct 14, 5:30 PM — Bloomfield - Talbott Hall 107 DEN - Deacon's Den
item.description:
In recognition of October as Domestic Violence Awareness Month, I would love the opportunity to collaborate with Greek Council on programming focused on healthy relationships, consent, communication, and recognizing signs of unhealthy or abusive relationships. This program would also provide students with information about resources available on campus and in the surrounding community, including confidential support and reporting options. The goal would be to create an open, supportive environment where students can learn practical tools for building healthy relationships while becoming more aware of how to support themselves and others.
Hosted by: Advocacy and Outreach, Bloomfield Greek Council
